High-fidelity Study Agent Chinese UI design specification, based on this approved research-notebook reference. Default product is 学习助手. Preserve neutral pale paper, navy ink, lemon highlighter, hairline notebook margin, open readable body and right learning margin notes. 80% sober academic reader, 20% purposeful hand-drawn annotation. No card walls, no rounded containers around prose/steps/state notes, no fake KPIs or counts, no dates, no computer frame or physical objects. All body/navigation/buttons/source text typeset code-native; handwriting ONLY one short secondary margin comment and thin circle/arrow. This is a mockup with footer 设计规范 · 示例内容, not a real verification record. Exact theme palette paper #FBFCFA, rail #F0F4F5, ink #203A51, muted #526879, blue #315B7C, yellow highlight #F5E7A0, confirmed green #2C6849, pending amber #875D17, failure red #9D3734. Chinese Source Han Serif/Noto Serif SC headings; clear Noto Sans SC body and chrome. Crisp text, restrained heading sizes, no huge marketing headline. Source is a scholarly footnote with a distinct clickable-looking 查看证据 control; never replace it with preview text. Always preserve a compact visible user question 能不能用一个例子解释？ above assistant response. Main topic 为什么注意力需要 softmax？. Assistant heading 先算相似度，再归一化，最后加权求和。, body and open centered formula softmax(QKᵀ / √d) V, open unboxed process 相似度 → 权重 → 加权求和, short highlighted phrase 权重总和为 1, small source block titled 关键证据 with one blue left rule and numbered source [1] Attention Is All You Need. User learning margin goal 理解注意力权重, 已确认 权重总和为 1, 待验证 为什么要除以 √d, 下一步 试着解释缩放的作用. No long invented citations or quotation claims. Composer 继续提问，或检验你的理解… and 发送. Three research options 单点核验 / 标准研究 / 深度研究; selection visibly marked by text plus dot and underline. Preserve clarity, whitespace, and code-buildable layout.
One full flat desktop screen, 1600x1000. Three columns: left session/progress rail 216px, right page-margin learning rail280px, middle flexible notebook content with text measure max760px. The main reading canvas and rails have straight boundaries, no enclosing large rounded wrapper. Left 学习助手 / 新建会话 / 当前会话 注意力机制 / 研究进度 with completed 搜索来源, completed 阅读来源, active 核对证据 (tiny dot and 正在核对, NOT all complete). Bottomleft 设置. Center title about32px, body18px, utility14px, formula28px. Right unboxed notes separated by sparse thin rules with labels+check/question/arrow icons. Bottom composer STICKY within CENTER COLUMN ONLY, not over left or right columns, 112px tall with input first row and modest research-mode options beneath. Keep user's question and 查看证据. A blue handwritten margin note 这里再想一步 connects to formula without crossing text.

Large clear readable Chinese, all typography consistent with notebook reference.
